> - **Technical SEO**: Improve site speed, mobile-friendliness, and schema markup.
> - **Backlinks**: Earn links from authoritative sites (e.g., industry blogs, news outlets).
> - **User experience**: Reduce bounce rates with clear navigation and engaging design.
>
> Tools like **Google Search Console**, **Ahrefs**, or **SEMrush** help track progress. Avoid shortcuts—Google’s algorithms penalize spammy tactics.

#### **2. Fraudulent Tactics (Black-Hat SEO) – Why They’re Harmful**
